podcast.body: Featured on "Station to Station," this song was inspired by a drug-induced hallucination or dream Bowie had with Iggy Pop, wherein an unidentified girlfriend was consumed by a holographic television, model TVC-15. It also reflected Bowie's immersion in the doomed spaceman character from "The Man Who Fell to Earth" and hinted at his future musical direction in the late 70s. "It was inspired by a dream, more likely a drug-induced hallucination with his friend, Ike Pop, where an unidentified girlfriend was eaten by a holographic television, model number, TVC-15."
